events.text:
T-234 is still blocked on the Tantra API key (T-337). The T-227 sender note didn't require any change to it.

**What I checked:**
- **Sender for invites:** T-234 sends reminder emails through a Tantra mailbox, not Google Calendar invites, so the T-227 invite sender doesn't apply to it. The go-live script `app/scripts/e2e-tantra-reminders-live.mjs` (lines 6 to 7 and 74) already sets the reminder sender to team@growthclub.org, which is the sender the Orchestrator picked for T-227. No edit was needed.
- **Waiting on T-227:** T-234 never waited on T-227. Its only blocker is the Tantra key, so there was nothing to clear.
- **Tantra key:** this stays as it was. T-337 is still blocked, waiting for Adi to create the key in the GrowthClub Tantra workspace and save it in Cohort Settings.

I recorded this on the task with pass.py, left it as blocked and acknowledged note R-8475fbce. I changed no files, so there was nothing to commit.
